harv.translation: abbr. 武装矿车（游戏单位）；高空研究飞行器（High Altitude Research Vechicle）；大迎角气动特性验证机

harvard.definition: n. American philanthropist who left his library and half his estate to the Massachusetts college that now bears his name (1607-1638)

harvard law school.translation: [法] 哈佛大学法学院, 哈佛法学院

harve.translation: n. (Harve)人名；(芬)哈尔韦；(法)阿尔夫

harvest.definition:
n. the consequence of an effort or activity
n. the gathering of a ripened crop
n. the season for gathering crops
v. remove from a culture or a living or dead body, as for the purposes of transplantation
harvest.translation:
n. 收获, 成果, 收获物, 收获期
v. 收割, 收获

harvest festival.translation: n. 收获节, 收获感恩节

harvest home.translation: 最后一批作物收割进仓

harvest moon.translation: n. 秋分前后的满月; 获月

harvestable.translation: a. 随时可收获的；收获的

harvested.definition:
v gather, as of natural products
v remove from a culture or a living or dead body, as for the purposes of transplantation
harvested.translation: v. 收割, 收成( harvest的过去式和过去分词 ); 收到; 收割（庄稼）, 捕猎（动物、鱼）

harvester.definition:
n. someone who helps to gather the harvest
n. farm machine that gathers a food crop from the fields
harvester.translation: n. 收获者, 收割机

harvesters.definition:
n. someone who helps to gather the harvest
n. farm machine that gathers a food crop from the fields
harvesters.translation: n. 收割庄稼的人, 收割机( harvester的复数形式 )

harvesting.definition:
n the gathering of a ripened crop
v gather, as of natural products
v remove from a culture or a living or dead body, as for the purposes of transplantation

harvestless.definition: a. Without harvest; lacking in crops; barren.
harvestless.translation: a. 不生产的, 无收获的

harvestman.definition: n. spiderlike arachnid with a small rounded body and very long thin legs

harvestmen.translation: n. 收割者, 盲蜘蛛( harvestman的名词复数 )

harvestry.definition: n. The act of harvesting; also, that which is harvested.

harvests.definition:
n the yield from plants in a single growing season
n the consequence of an effort or activity
n the gathering of a ripened crop
n the season for gathering crops
v gather, as of natural products
v remove from a culture or a living or dead body, as for the purposes of transplantation
harvests.translation:
n. 收割( harvest的名词复数 ); 收获季节; 收成; 结果
v. 收割, 收成( harvest的第三人称单数 ); 收到; 收割（庄稼）, 捕猎（动物、鱼）

harvey.definition: n. English physician and scientist who described the circulation of the blood; he later proposed that all animals originate from an ovum produced by the female of the species (1578-1657)

harvey cushing.translation: [网络] 哈维库欣；神经外科医生柯兴；内分泌学家库欣

harvey wallbanger.translation: [网络] 哈维撞墙；撞墙的哈维；撞墙哈维

harveyizing.translation: 哈尔维法钢硬化, 哈尔维法渗碳硬化
